notes.title: New pricing on Xcinerator!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 

We want to thank everyone for their positive feedback and discussion about our newest release Xcinerator. We've heard your feedback and have decided to go with a new pricing strategy so everyone can use this product. Stay tuned for this new price drop! 

As always, we're here for you should you require any assistance with this software or you have any additional feedback / questions.

Thanks again for your support!
